name: Net Dividend Rate Type 6 Code
definition: Specifies the type of dividend rate.

CAPO.name: Capital Portion
CAPO.definition: Rate relating to the underlying security for which capital is distributed.

CDFI.name: Foreign Income
CDFI.definition: Rate relating to a foreign income type such as a conduit foreign income.

FLFR.name: Fully Franked
FLFR.definition: Rate resulting from a fully franked dividend paid by a company; the rate includes tax credit for companies that have made sufficient tax payments during the fiscal period.

INCO.name: Income Portion
INCO.definition: Rate relating to the underlying security for which income is distributed.

INTR.name: Interest
INTR.definition: Rate relating to the underlying security for which interest is paid.

REES.name: Real Estate Property Income Portion
REES.definition: Rate of income distribution originated by real estate investment.

SOIC.name: Sundry Or Other Income
SOIC.definition: Rate relating to the underlying security for which other income is paid.

TXBL.name: Taxable Portion
TXBL.definition: Rate relating to the underlying security for which tax is charged.

TXDF.name: Tax Deferred
TXDF.definition: Rate relating to the underlying security for which tax is deferred.

TXFR.name: Tax Free
TXFR.definition: Rate relating to the underlying security which is not taxable.

UNFR.name: Unfranked
UNFR.definition: Rate resulting from an unfranked dividend paid by a company; the rate does not include tax credit and is subject to withholding tax.
